name: An Old Adventurer's Hut
license: GPL-3.0 (the game's own license; see LICENSE.txt)
description: A hut in the woods of Shandalar. The old man inside sells, for 1000 gold, the way to a dungeon nobody else knows of.
learning_note: A self-contained place, and a study for the places players wish for: one sites plugin with one place, three panes, a price paid once and a dungeon raised from the plugin's own card list. Original fiction, not official Magic canon.
